lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Good evening. Welcome. How many people?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Would you like to hear today's specials?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, please. What is the soup?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: It is vegetable soup with bread.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That sounds nice. Could I have vegetable tacos instead?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Of course. Would you like water?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, please. Is the soup spicy?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Perfect. We'll have one soup and three tacos.
